queries_run: EMCOR Group customer concentration risk largest customers percent of revenue 10-K
EMCOR EME customer bankruptcy OR downgrade OR guidance cut 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因素：客戶可隨時單方面減少、不續約或終止合約，失去重要客戶可能有重大不利影響；未揭露單一客戶占營收百分比。
findings.excerpt: Although we provide services to a diverse portfolio of end markets and have long-standing relationships with many of our significant customers, our customers may unilaterally reduce, fail to renew, or terminate their contracts with us at any time.

findings.claim: FY2025 營收來源分散：97% 美國、72% 營建、21% 建築服務、7% 工業服務；<$10M 專案占電機機械營建營收約 42%。
findings.excerpt: We derive revenues from many different customers in numerous industries, which have operations in several different geographical areas.

findings.claim: 2024 年曾因特定客戶破產提列 $11.0M 準備，影響美國建築服務部門利潤率 30bp。
findings.excerpt: The results of this segment for the year ended December 31, 2024 included an $11.0 million reserve for a specific customer bankruptcy within its commercial site-based services division, which negatively impacted the segment’s operating margin by 30 basis points in such prior year period.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋未找到前幾大客戶占比量化揭露，亦未見 2026 年客戶破產或評等調降新聞（搜尋摘要稱 2026 Q2 上調全年指引，未取得原文故不列 finding）。
